description: Standardize intake form, required fields, routing taxonomy, status dashboard, and requestor comms; no CLM-embedded AI in phase one.
primary_value_levers: missing intake field reduction; fewer status inquiries; faster routing
major_risks: May feel like process hygiene rather than AI transformation.
why_this_matters_for_demo: Useful prerequisite but too small for a high-impact CXO demo.

scenario: CLM-embedded assisted triage and obligation extraction
description: Guided intake, AI completeness checks, risk/obligation extraction, attorney approval workflow, status visibility, and Tower metrics.
delivery_model: Boutique-led hybrid with client Legal Ops and selective offshore data/QA
primary_value_levers: 8-12% cycle-time improvement; reduced status inquiries; obligation owner completeness; outside counsel triage avoidance directional
major_risks: Integration and privilege controls; adoption by requestors; finance proof for hard savings.
why_this_matters_for_demo: Best balance of visible AI, human control, speed, economics, and board-grade credibility.

description: New orchestration layer across CLM, ServiceNow, mailbox, vendor risk, Coupa, renewal calendar, and reporting workflows.
primary_value_levers: broader automation; cross-system visibility; obligation control at scale
major_risks: High integration/change risk before baseline proof; expensive; slower to demonstrate value.
why_this_matters_for_demo: Potential future state, but too risky before phase-one proof.

description: Drive configuration, data preparation, QA, and dashboards offshore with thin onshore legal/product leadership.
delivery_model: Offshore delivery partner with onshore client ownership
primary_value_levers: lower implementation cost; faster data cleanup; basic dashboarding
major_risks: Legal nuance, privilege, workflow design, and adoption risk may overwhelm savings.
why_this_matters_for_demo: Shows why cheapest delivery is not necessarily best for legal/control-heavy work.

description: Full advisory, controls, operating model, CLM architecture, integration roadmap, and change program led by large SI.
delivery_model: Big 4 type SI with offshore factory
primary_value_levers: enterprise governance; scalable architecture; executive confidence
major_risks: Cost and scope can outrun phase-one evidence; slower pilot learning.
why_this_matters_for_demo: Useful comparison to make boutique hybrid economics credible.
